subject.title: feat: import local browser login from the macOS app

question: Should the macOS app adopt the linked consent-first browser-login import workflow as the supported native UX over the existing host-local browser plugin APIs?
rationale: The aligned feature adds a credential-handling setup flow and persisted default-profile mutation, and its protected maintainer label requires explicit product ownership.

options.title: Sponsor linked PR
options.body: Accept the native flow after real signed-app proof and exact-head review confirm consent, isolation, failure rollback, and credential boundaries.

options.title: Retain manual import
options.body: Keep the existing CLI and browser-tool workflow without app-owned prompting or default selection.

recommendation.title: Sponsor linked PR
recommendation.body: Accept the native flow after real signed-app proof and exact-head review confirm consent, isolation, failure rollback, and credential boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the underlying import behavior, owns the issue, and authored the direct implementation candidate.
